title: Saturday - Ziyarat of Holy Prophet (s)
introduction:
ZIYARAH ON SATURDAYS

ZIYARAH OF THE HOLY PROPHET

Then repeat the following three times:

Then say the following:

As for myself, ‘Abbas al-Qummi the author of this book, whenever I address this form of Ziyarah to the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) I begin with the following form that Imam al-Rida(a.s.) taught to al-Bizanti. In this respect, it has been authentically narrated that when Abu-Basir asked him about the most proper form of visiting the Holy Prophet’s tomb and invoking Allah’s salutations upon him after the prayer, Imam Ali ibn Musa al-Rida(a.s.) answered that he may say:

verses.arabic: اَشْهَدُ اَنْ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ
verses.translation: I bear witness that there is no god save Allah;
alone without having any partner;
and I bear witness that you are His messenger

verses.arabic: وَ اَنَّكَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللّٰهِ
verses.translation: and you are Muhammad, the son of 'Abdullah.

verses.arabic: وَ اَشْهَدُ اَنَّكَ قَدْ بَلَّغْتَ رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّكَ
verses.translation: And I bear witness that you have truly conveyed the missions of your Lord,
well-wished for your nation,
striven hard in the way of Allah
by means of wisdom and excellent preaching,

verses.arabic: وَ اَدَّيْتَ الَّذِي عَلَيْكَ مِنَ الْحَقِّ
verses.translation: and fulfilled the duty that is incumbent upon you;
and you have been sympathetic with the believers
and unyielding to the unbelievers;
and you have worshipped Allah sincerely
until death came upon you.

verses.arabic: فَبَلَغَ اللهُ بِكَ اَشْرَفَ مَحَلِّ الْمُكَرَّمِيْنَ
verses.translation: Allah therefore has lifted you up to the most honorable place of the honored ones.
All praise be to Allah Who has saved us, through you,
from polytheism and deviation.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِهِ
verses.translation: O Allah, (please) send blessings to Muhammad and his Household,

verses.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْ صَلَوَاتِكَ وَ صَلَوَاتِ مَلاَۤئِكَتِكَ
verses.translation: and make Your blessings, the blessings of Your angels,
Your prophets, the Messengers,
Your righteous servants,
the inhabitants of the heavens and the [layers of the] earth,

verses.arabic: وَ مَنْ سَبَّحَ لَكَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
verses.translation: and ever one who glorifies You, O Lord of the worlds,
from the past and the late generations,
be on Muhammad, Your servant, messenger,
prophet, trustee,
elite, most-beloved,
elect, choice,
dignitary, select,
and the best of Your creatures.
And grant him preference, virtue,
[right of] mediation, and sublime rank;
and send him a praiseworthy status
which all the past and the late generations wish to have.
O Allah, You have said:

verses.arabic: وَ لَوْ اَنَّهُمْ اِذْ ظَلَمُوْا اَنْفُسَهُمْ
verses.translation: “And had they, when they were unjust to themselves,
come to you and asked forgiveness of Allah,
and the Messenger had also asked forgiveness for them,
they would have found Allah Oft-returning to mercy, Merciful.”
O my God, I have come to Your Prophet, seeking forgiveness of You
and repenting before You from my sins;
so, (please) send blessings to Muhammad and his Household
and forgive them for me.
O our master,
I turn by you and by your Household

verses.arabic: اِلٰى اللّٰهِ تَعَالٰى رَبِّكَ وَ رَبِّي
verses.translation: towards Allah, the Exalted, your and my Lord,
so that He may forgive me.

verses.arabic: اِنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَ اِنَّا اِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُوْنَ
verses.translation: Verily, we are Allah's and verily unto Him shall we return.
We are stricken by losing you, O beloved of our hearts!
Too shocking is our misfortune of losing you!
Because the Revelation has been interrupted
and because we have missed you.

verses.arabic: فَاِنَّا لِلّٰهِ وَ اِنَّا اِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُوْنَ
verses.translation: Nevertheless, we are Allah’s and to Him shall we return.
O our master, O Allah’s Messenger!

verses.arabic: صَلَوَاتُ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْكَ وَ عَلٰى اٰلِ بَيْتِكَ [الطَّيِّبِيْنَ‏] الطَّاهِرِيْنَ
verses.translation: May Allah’s blessings be upon you and upon your Household, the immaculate.

verses.arabic: هٰذَا يَوْمُ السَّبْتِ وَ هُوَ يَوْمُكَ
verses.translation: This day is Saturday, which is your day,

verses.arabic: وَ اَنَا فِيْهِ ضَيْفُكَ وَ جَارُكَ
verses.translation: and on this day I am your guest and in your vicinity;
so, receive me as your guest and as your neighbor.
Indeed, you are generous and hospitable
and you are commanded [by Allah] to host your neighbors.
So, receive me as your guest and treat me hospitably;
and accept us as your neighbors and treat us in due hospitability;

verses.arabic: بِمَنْزِلَةِ اللّٰهِ عِنْدَكَ وَ عِنْدَ اٰلِ بَيْتِكَ
verses.translation: [I ask you] in the name of Allah’s standing with you and with your Household
and in the name of their standing with Him
and in the name of the knowledge that He has entrusted with you all.
Verily, He is the most generous of all those who show generosity.
Peace be upon you, O Allah’s Messenger.
May Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you,too.

verses.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللّٰهِ
verses.translation: Peace be upon you, O Muhammad, the son of 'Abdullah.
Peace be upon you, O most preferred of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O most-beloved of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O choicest of Allah.
Peace be upon you, O trustee of Allah.
I bear witness that you are the messenger of Allah

verses.arabic: وَ اَشْهَدُ اَنَّكَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللّٰهِ
verses.translation: and I bear witness that you are Muhammad, the son of 'Abdullah.

verses.arabic: وَ اَشْهَدُ اَنَّكَ قَدْ نَصَحْتَ لِاُمَّتِكَ
verses.translation: And I bear witness that you have truly well-wished for your nation,
striven hard in the way of your Lord,
and worshipped Him until death came upon you.
May Allah reward you, O Allah’s Messenger,

verses.arabic: اَفْضَلَ مَا جَزٰى نَبِيًّا عَنْ اُمَّتِهِ
verses.translation: with the best of that with which He has ever rewarded a Prophet on behalf of his people.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
verses.translation: O Allah, (please) send blessings to Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad

verses.arabic: اَفْضَلَ مَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلٰى اِبْرَاهِيْمَوَ اٰلِ اِبْرَاهِيْمَ
verses.translation: with the best blessings You have ever conferred upon Abraham and the Household of Abraham.
Verily, You are All-laudable, All-glorious.
